workflow: Generated sequentially, one prompt per shot, with inspection before the next shot. Only three requested scenes were revised.

prompts.prompt: Generate ONE finished 16:9 storybook game background for the CLOSED LANDED CAPSULE shot, based STRICTLY on the SECOND attached reference image (the slide with closed capsule on left and overhead lander on right). Reproduce ONLY its LEFT shot as a full standalone illustration. Match its camera distance and placement: one CLOSED three-sided tetrahedral Pathfinder lander prominently centered, occupying about40% image width and50% image height, surrounded by collapsed wrinkled airbag lobes across foreground. Low Martian ridges behind; horizon around40% height; no enormous empty sky. Triangular sloping panels meet at a top apex; one small plain circular fitting in front face as the pencil drawing, NOT a cockpit or eye. No visible rover until opening. No legs, rocket, round cabin or additional spacecraft. Warm golden orange Mars, peach yellow light, cool gray metal with subtle warm foil, simplified graphic shapes with textured gouache and gentle hand-drawn edges, charming illustrated narrative game. EXACT one shot not a collage, no text, slide borders, arrows, UI or labels. Keep whole lander and airbags in frame with safe margins. The first and third attachments are context only, do NOT combine scenes.

ONE standalone16:9 storybook game illustration of Pathfinder OPENING REVEAL, based STRICTLY on RIGHT lower overhead drawing of attached storyboard page9. First input is authoritative shot geometry; second closed-capsule illustration is supporting palette only. Camera true TOP DOWN straight90degrees, no horizon or sky. Match drawing: three opened hinged triangular petals form a THREE-point arrangement around a single triangular base; one points UP, second DOWN-LEFT, third DOWN-RIGHT. Keep the little rectangular Sojourner rover stowed lengthwise near upper central area on a petal, tiny broad dark NAVY rectangular solar panel seen FROM ABOVE, six wheels THREE along EACH long side; no expressive rear eyes, no second rover. Lower central base has compact equipment boxes, NOT another rover. Golden warm airbag fabric flattened around perimeter on orange rocky ground. The stowed Sojo must be immediately recognizable and clearly separated from equipment by a subtle warm gold halo as drawn. Central equipment/petals remain proportionally broad simple metal panels as reference, do NOT turn all three petals into identical giant photovoltaic triangles; small real solar areas okay but prioritize drawing. At least12% empty margin around FULL open lander. Hand-painted gouache warm golden orange, cool cyan-gray metal, charming fine sketch edges matching supporting palette. No giant mast added, no circular cockpit, no fourth petal, no text or arrows or UI or slide borders. Draw exactly ONE overhead scene, no collage.

Create ONE finished16:9 first-person game illustration matching attached latest page11 drawing EXACTLY in camera setup. Authoritative reference is its large binocular-POV pencil scene. Viewer IS tiny Sojourner sitting at the TOP of a deployment ramp, looking DOWN the ramp onto a broad Martian plain. Foreground: two slim gray ramp rails begin at bottom-left-of-center and bottom-right-of-center, converge toward mid lower center where ramp reaches reddish sand, clearly sloping away from camera. Ramp occupies central lower30% with visible shallow cross ribs. Several rounded scattered rocks left and right on dirt; distant low angular mountain ridges across middle-height horizon; one small warm sun upper-center-right. NO full rover, face, solar panel stretching across foreground, cockpit, cabin, glass, steering wheel, lander or humans. Keep overall composition very close to pencil image: horizon high-middle, ramp lower-center, large rock at middle-left and small rock middle-right. Warm simplified orange/ochre terrain, pale golden sky, fine charcoal blue-gray accents, charming textured gouache storybook. Leave corners low detail; binocular lens framing and four small scan corner marks will be added IN CODE, do not bake any lens, frame, text, UI, numbers or labels into art. Standalone scene, no slide borders or caption.
